audience: People and local tools that receive mail from multiple IMAP mailboxes and must reply through the mailbox that received each message
problem: Operating multiple mailboxes usually fragments message state and encourages copying provider credentials into each client or automation
promise: One self-hosted local inbox that preserves mailbox identity on every message and reply while keeping resolved credentials in Skarbiec

secondaryAction.label: View source
secondaryAction.purpose: Inspect the canonical Apache-2.0 implementation and product contract

approvedClaims.claim: Skrzynka receives mail from multiple IMAP mailboxes and replies through the mailbox that received each message.
Mailbox credentials remain in Skarbiec; Skrzynka stores exact item references and resolves secrets only while opening IMAP or SMTP.
The service exposes a CLI and authenticated loopback-only JSON API.
Skrzynka records synchronization and reply state in a local SQLite database, deduplicates messages by mailbox and IMAP UID, and protects against ambiguous sends.
approvedClaims.evidence: skrzynka/README.md sections "What works now" (poll/deduplicate bullet and SQLite bullet)

requiredProof: A concrete three-step product workflow from selecting a Skarbiec mailbox identity through IMAP synchronization to replying with the originating SMTP identity
A real first-local-mailbox command sequence using skrzynka status, mailbox add, sync, and message list
Visible links to the canonical Skrzynka documentation and source repository

rules: Use the canonical Wisent mark and the Skrzynka sky accent on the shared dark product-surface system.
Use concrete operational language; do not imply a hosted shared inbox, automatic replies, or credential storage outside Skarbiec.

forbidden: Claims that Skrzynka generates replies, sends automatic replies, exposes a remote shared server, or stores resolved mailbox credentials
